common.tagline: Your procedure in Tunisia, fully taken care of

footer.about: LifeDeux organises your procedure in Tunisia: appointment, airport transfer, accommodation and follow-up.
footer.privacy: Your data is encrypted and only shared with your surgeon. Emails and bank statements stay discreet.

home.heroSubtitle: Choose your surgeon, book your slot and let us handle the rest: airport pick-up, accommodation during recovery and your trip home.

appointment.title: Appointments
appointment.text: Real-time slots, confirmed by the surgeon.

transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.text: Airport welcome and shuttle to your stay.

stay.title: Accommodation
stay.text: Apartments and houses selected for recovery.

home.howSubtitle: Five simple steps, from booking to your trip home.

1.title: Choose
1.text: The procedure, then the surgeon that suits you.

2.title: Book
2.text: Pick an available slot and send your request.

3.title: Confirmation
3.text: The surgeon confirms your appointment shortly.

4.title: Options & payment
4.text: Add transfer and accommodation, then pay online.

5.title: Your QR pass
5.text: Show it on arrival: we take care of the rest.
